extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually. Online engines send note text to their providers, while a locally hosted model keeps requests on the user's machine. The frog button has no secondary menu or selection-translation action.
problem: Reading foreign-language notes in Obsidian means switching to an outside translator or editing the note to paste translations in.
